events.title: Demo Update: v0.3.0.3674
events.summary: This update includes the following fixes:Fixed an issue where city gates could become blocked after transitioning to a new map.Fixed an issue where buildings could overlap after transitioning to a new map.Fixed an issue where some units could get stuck inside barracks and be unable to leave.Thank you for your feedback and support! Please let us know if you encounter any other issues.

events.title: Loulan Kingdom's Demo Is Out Now! We're Joining Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Your Majesties,Loulan Kingdom demo is now available for free on Steam! We'll also be joining the upcoming Steam Next Fest, and we'd love for you to give it a try!The demo includes the first two chapters and two randomized biomes. You'll build an oasis city-state, welcome travelers from the Silk Road, and personally lead your troops against invaders as you guide your kingdom through a variety of challenges.Meanwhile, the previous Playtest has now closed. events.title: Loulan Kingdom Playtest Is Now Live!
events.summary: We're excited to announce that the Loulan Kingdom Playtest is now live! Jump in and embark on a thrilling adventure in an oasis kingdom! The game is still in beta, with content and features evolving rapidly. You may encounter bugs or other issues as you play, and we welcome your feedback! Thank you for your support, Your Majesties!

events.title: Returning from WePlay Expo 2025 — We’ve gained so much!
events.summary: We just returned from the 2025 Shanghai WePlay Expo last week, and we’re still filled with excitement and emotions from those unforgettable two days.For a small indie team like us, bringing our game to an offline exhibition for real players to try for the very first time was both nerve-wracking and something we had been eagerly looking forward to!“Loulan Kingdom” showcased at the Unreal Engine boothPlayers trying out “Loulan Kingdom” at WePlayThe passion from players was our greatest rewardWatch

events.title: Loulan Kingdom Steam Page Is Now Live!
events.summary: Hey everyone! We’re Mocking Crown Games, a two-person indie team. After months of sand, sweat, and code, we’re thrilled to announce that 🎉 the Steam page for Loulan Kingdom is now live!Loulan Kingdom is a city-building survival game set on a desert oasis. As the ruler of Loulan, you’ll build and defend your kingdom, serve travelers of the Silk Road, earn fame and fortune, and face the inevitable fall beneath the shifting sands of fate.👉 Visit our Steam page and add it to your wishlist now!
